The comments at RefreshScheduler.swift:106-112 and AppEnvironment.swift:53-59 say a scheduled tick 'ALWAYS' finds an expired cache. That is only true when the fetch takes under 5 s, because the sleep starts when refreshAll is dispatched, not when the fetch finishes. With BUG-ART-010 in place, a slow vendor records half as many samples. This is not a regression, but the comment is wrong. Starting the sleep after the refresh completes, or setting the cache mtime at the tick instead, would make the claim true.
